reviews.title: Super fun and engaging
reviews.body:
I’ve really enjoyed playing this game.  It realistically captures what it must be line to build a company from the ground up. Making decisions like choosing my initial routes and appropriate type of plane and seeing how those decisions affected my bottom line was amazing.  Experimenting with allowing my airline to grow organically versus taking advantage of loans to grow my airline faster was really cool.  There are so many layers to this game.  For example , once my airline was established, I could see how much competition I had from other carriers, and choose to do things like establishing a hub, doing an ad campaign, providing loyalty program, etc.
 
Great game!

de.title: Super spaßig und fesselnd
de.body:
Mir hat es richtig Spaß gemacht, dieses Spiel zu spielen. Es fängt realistisch ein, wie es wohl sein muss, ein Unternehmen von Grund auf aufzubauen. Entscheidungen zu treffen, etwa meine ersten Routen und den passenden Flugzeugtyp auszuwählen, und zu sehen, wie sich diese Entscheidungen auf meinen Gewinn ausgewirkt haben, war großartig. Damit zu experimentieren, ob ich meine Airline organisch wachsen lasse oder Kredite nutze, um sie schneller wachsen zu lassen, war echt cool. Dieses Spiel hat so viele Ebenen. Sobald meine Airline etabliert war, konnte ich zum Beispiel sehen, wie viel Konkurrenz ich durch andere Fluggesellschaften hatte, und mich dafür entscheiden, etwa ein Drehkreuz aufzubauen, eine Werbekampagne zu starten, ein Treueprogramm anzubieten usw.
 
Tolles Spiel!

reviews.title: Great Simple Aviation Game
reviews.body:
Thank you for updating your game consistently. This game is addictive and can occupy hours of play. I appreciate the ability to merge or acquire other airlines. Some suggestions:  
• Could we adjust how stops are added on routes so longer paths become possible? For example, HKG to EZE? Even when I tried adding a stop at LAX, the system would not allow the route.  
• Could we add a filter in the Route tab to separate routes from different hubs? Or from different airlines after a merger?  
• Could we include a filter in Route to sort from oldest to newest?  
• Once two airlines merge, could we use separate liveries?  
• Could we have the A359-ULR and A35K-ULR?  
Thank you and cheers!!

Danke, dass du dein Spiel regelmäßig aktualisierst. Dieses Spiel macht süchtig und kann einen stundenlang beschäftigen. Ich schätze die Möglichkeit, mit anderen Airlines zu fusionieren oder sie zu übernehmen. Ein paar Vorschläge:  
• Könnte man anpassen, wie Zwischenstopps zu Routen hinzugefügt werden, damit längere Strecken möglich werden? Zum Beispiel HKG nach EZE? Selbst als ich versucht habe, einen Zwischenstopp in LAX einzufügen, hat das System die Route nicht zugelassen.  
• Könnte man im Routen-Tab einen Filter hinzufügen, um Routen von verschiedenen Drehkreuzen zu trennen? Oder von verschiedenen Airlines nach einer Fusion?  
• Könnte man bei den Routen einen Filter einbauen, um von der ältesten zur neuesten zu sortieren?  
• Könnte man nach der Fusion zweier Airlines getrennte Lackierungen verwenden?  
• Könnten wir den A359-ULR und den A35K-ULR bekommen?  
Danke und Grüße!!

reviews.title: Great game - Few ideas
reviews.body:
This is the most all-encompassing business simulation game I’ve run into on the App Store, and I really appreciate the developer’s response to all the reviews. Super cool game, highly recommend.

Few ideas:
-It would be really cool if we could update liveries for acquired airlines separate from our own, and more options for our own liveries would be awesome in general
-Easier plane purchase after choosing a route, for example the plane options being limited to planes with ranges long enough to complete the route, and a filter option that allows us to see which planes are overall “optimal” for the route in order from most to least within the required range
-For the ops tab, a separate “longhaul” or “international” tab would be super cool for overseas flights, and a tab for significantly shorter turboprop flights as well
-Some kind of way to see if hubs have a route between each other or not would be really cool as well, maybe another ops tab that just suggests routes between hubs

de.title: Tolles Spiel - ein paar Ideen
de.body:
Das ist die umfassendste Wirtschaftssimulation, die mir im App Store begegnet ist, und ich schätze es sehr, dass der Entwickler auf alle Bewertungen antwortet. Super cooles Spiel, klare Empfehlung.

Ein paar Ideen:
-Es wäre richtig cool, wenn man die Lackierungen übernommener Airlines getrennt von der eigenen ändern könnte, und mehr Optionen für die eigene Lackierung wären generell super
-Einfacherer Flugzeugkauf, nachdem man eine Route gewählt hat, zum Beispiel, dass nur Flugzeuge mit genug Reichweite für die Route zur Auswahl stehen, und ein Filter, der zeigt, welche Flugzeuge insgesamt „optimal“ für die Route sind, sortiert vom besten zum schlechtesten innerhalb der nötigen Reichweite
-Im Betrieb-Tab wäre ein eigener Tab „Langstrecke“ oder „International“ für Überseeflüge super cool, und auch einer für deutlich kürzere Turboprop-Flüge
-Irgendeine Möglichkeit zu sehen, ob zwischen Drehkreuzen schon eine Route besteht oder nicht, wäre auch richtig cool, vielleicht ein weiterer Betrieb-Tab, der einfach Routen zwischen Drehkreuzen vorschlägt

reviews.title: Has potential but needs a lot of work
reviews.body:
Very nice concept but it needs a lot of improvements. 

Here are my suggestions:

There is a bug in the maintenance section, you can’t scroll down to your other hubs to open another maintenance base. 

When buying another airline, you get all their assets but not the crew members. You end up having a bunch of airplanes and routes and a lot of pop-up messages that there is no crew available to operate these planes and routes. In reality it shouldn’t be like that, when you buy an airline it should include all the staff. 

In the crew section there should be an ability to add more simulators. Only 4 slots is not realistic and not enough when the airline becomes bigger. Some airlines in the real world own over 20 simulators. 

I didn’t find an option to fire crew members. There should be one. For example I was slowly phasing out a specific fleet but the amount of crew members remained the same without the ability to reduce it.

Add an ability to schedule an airplane on multiple routes in a day not only a round trip of a single destination. That’s not true in the real airline world. Airplanes should be flown to multiple destinations in a day and also have pre scheduled down time for maintenance. 

Maintenance pop-ups are very annoying, there should be an option to automate or select a default course of action when planes break down. 

When purchasing an aircraft, add to the aircraft in the marketplace its operational cost. For example a Boeing 737 max 8 is more fuel-efficient than a Boeing 737-800, etc. 

Increase the ability to zoom in the map. Some areas like New York due to the proximity of the airports to each other you sometimes need to click multiple times to select the desired airport. 

Add more marketing options such as launching a credit card, sponsoring athletic events and teams, and making donations to charities to increase airline popularity. 

Add more staffing options. Not only pilots, but also flight attendants, mechanics, dispatchers, etc. 

Add an ability to customize the interior of the aircraft such as wifi, screens, seating configuration, etc. this plays a big role in the airline industry.

Add random events of charter flights opportunities such as FIFA World Cup, football teams, military charter, etc. 

There are many other improvements or ideas that can make this game really fun and realistic.

Best of luck!

reviews.title: Interesting, could benefit from a few tweaks
reviews.body:
I like the game/simulation. The 5-route free intro and the low one-time price are a welcome improvement over pay-to-win and subscription models. If there were a forum somewhere to post and discuss about this app, I would do so.

The game/simulation is reasonably detailed, but I think a few small changes could make it better:
1. There should be a straightforward way of adding and removing planes (or at least substituting a new plane) on a route, even if accompanied by a small fee. Having to close and reopen it doesn’t seem realistic.
2. The “labor actions” are rather arbitrary and very frequent, much more so than in real life. There should at least be a concrete demand that the player might decide to negotiate or even just meet.
3. Crew training should be capable of being spread out. It is not realistic for half the crews to suddenly be out on training.
4. It should be possible to move crews from available to reserve, reducing ongoing cost, but of course incurring cost to reactivate.
5. Crew salaries should be adjustable by the player (as part of #2-#4). Some crew might do a labor action or just quit if pay isn’t competitive.
6. There should be an even faster 125x (perhaps sans animation), but the simulation should automatically drop to 1x from anything higher when critical alerts pop up.
7. An adjustable budget for prevetative maintenance ought to affect aircraft readiness (groundings).
Larger changes to improve realism:
1. It would be cool if planes were scheduled point to point, with multiple points possible, rather than just dedicated back-and-forth on a route. Each plane having a daily schedule would suffice, and this would of course affect crew availability, resting, etc. at each served airport. The totality of these would determine possible ticketable through-connections.
2. It would make hubs and larger route structures more realistic if demand (and pricing?) were calculated endpoint-to endpoint, assuming a bump for non-stop, and falling way off for out of the way connections (like IAD->ATL->LGA, for example), rather than using a universal hub demand bonus.
